name: awesome-compilers
desc: :sunglasses: Curated list of awesome resources on Compilers, Interpreters and Runtimes

resources.name: Computer Systems: A Programmer’s Perspective
resources.desc: General treatment of Computer Systems including Compilers, Interpreters and Runtimes.

resources.name: Elements of Computing Systems
resources.desc: How to build a computer from Nand Gates all the way to Compilers and Operating Systems.

resources.name: Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs
resources.desc: Study the building blocks of computation using Scheme by building a Scheme interpreter in a Scheme!

resources.name: Basics of Compiler Design
resources.desc: Provides a short treatment of the basic concepts.

resources.name: Beautiful Racket
resources.desc: How to make your own Programming Language with Racket.

resources.name: Build Your Own Lisp
resources.desc: Learn C and build your own Lisp Programming Language in 1000 LoC.

resources.name: Compilers: Principles, Techniques and Tools
resources.desc: The Dragons Book. A classic textbook on Compiler Construction.

resources.name: Crafting Interpreters
resources.desc: An all-stop-shop for learning (nearly) everything you need to learn to build an interpreted, full-featured, efficient scripting language.

resources.name: Create Your Own Programming Languauge
resources.desc: Example-driven approach to building your own programming language with video tutorials and source code projects.

resources.name: Engineering a Compiler
resources.desc: The modern textbook on Compilers Construction, covering SSA-Form and recent research on Code Generation.

resources.name: Essentials of Programming Languages
resources.desc: Fundamental concepts of programming languages with a focus on Semantics, Interpretation and CPS (Continuation Passing Style).

resources.name: Language Implementation Patterns
resources.desc: Learn the patterns behind building programming languages and build an interpreter yourself, using ANTLR.

resources.name: Modern Compiler Implementation in ML
resources.desc: Build a compiler using ML (MetaLanguage) with a textbook that has one of the best coverage on all compiler stages. The book comes with a reference compiler implementation to guide your software development process.

resources.name: Programming Language Pragmatics
resources.desc: Integrated treatement of language design and implementation, the examples feature famous architectures like ARM and x86 64-bit.

resources.name: Programming Languages: Application and Interpretation
resources.desc: Excellent introduction to the subject that uses an incremental approach to building programs. The mistakes are included too to highlight key concepts.

resources.name: Programming Languages: Theory and Practice
resources.desc: Collected lecture notes for the _Programming Languages_ course taught at Carnegie Mellon University, most suitable as an introductory text on the subject.

resources.name: Project Oberon
resources.desc: The design of an operating system and compiler.

resources.name: The BEAM Book
resources.desc: Description of the ERTS (Erlang Runtime System) and the BEAM Virtual Machine.

resources.name: Virtual Machines
resources.desc: Good book on how to build Virtual Machines especially tailored for the topic of building Programming Languages.

resources.name: Virtual Machines: Versatile Platforms for Systems and Processes
resources.desc: Key textbook on the subject of Virtual Machines which examines virtual machine technologies across the disciplines that use them, e.g.: OS and Programming Languages.

resources.name: Write a Compiler in Go
resources.desc: Well-known introduction to the Go programming language and its ecosystem through building a Compiler project.

resources.name: Write an Interpreter in Go
resources.desc: Successor of the "Write a Compiler in Go" book, but this one builds an interpreter project instead.

resources.name: Writing Compilers and Interpreters: A Software Engineering Approach
resources.desc: How to build Compilers using Java, this book is tailored for the working Software Engineer.

resources.name: Writing Interpreters and Compilers for the Raspberry Pi Using Python
resources.desc: If you want to learn how to write interpreters and compilers, and at the same time learn how Python, Python bytecode, assembly language, and dynamic typing work, this is the book for you.

resources.name: Advanced Compiler Design and Implementation
resources.desc: In-depth treatement of advanced design topics such as: Intermediate Representation, SSA, Code Optimization and the various processor architectures.

resources.name: Advanced Design and Implementation of Virtual Machines
resources.desc: Step-by-step hollistic introduction to the design of Virtual Machine architectures, topics and algorithms. Contains illustrated figures and implementations for the algorithms in the book.

resources.name: Advanced Topics in Types and Programming Languages
resources.desc: Intensive study of Type Systems, covering topics such as, but not limited to: Precise Type Analyses; Type Systems for Low-Level Languages and Advanced Techniques in ML-style Type Inference..

resources.name: A Retargetable C Compiler: Design and Implementation
resources.desc: Examines the design and implementation of Icc, a production-quality, retargetable compiler, designed at AT&T Bell Labs for the ANSI C programming language.

resources.name: Building an Optimizing Compiler
resources.desc: Fills the gap in the domain of code optimization. This book provides a high level design for a thorough optimizer, code generator, scheduler and register allocator for a generic modern RISC processor.

resources.name: Compiling with Continuations
resources.desc: Introduction to CPS (Continuation-Passing Style) as an Intermediate Representation in Compiler for doing optimizations and program transformations.

resources.name: Design Concepts in Programming Languages
resources.desc: Systematic exploration of techniques and ideas used in Programming Language Design, covers topics such as: Operational and Denotational Semantic techniques, Dynamic Semantic techniques and Static Semantic techniques.

resources.name: Instruction Level Parallelism
resources.desc: This book precisely formulates and simplifies the presentation of Instruction Level Parallelism (ILP) compilation techniques.

resources.name: Linkers and Loaders
resources.desc: Definitive text on the compile-time and runtime processes of linking and loading.

resources.name: Optimizing Compilers for Modern Architectures
resources.desc: Optimizing program generation based on recent gains and breakthroughs in modern high-performance CPU architectures.

resources.name: Parsing Techniques: A Practical Guide
resources.desc: Definitive guide on parsing algorithms and techniques, also contains an introduction to Formal Grammar and Parsing Theory.

resources.name: The Garbage Collection Handbook: The Art of Automatic Memory Management
resources.desc: The living-classic and definitive text on the topic of Garbage Collection, also covers hardware-based optimizations in light of modern advances in CPU architectures.

resources.name: The Implementation of Functional Programming Languages
resources.desc: Classic textbook on implementing Functional Languages, covers Structured Types, Pattern Matching Semantics, Lambda Calculus Transformation, Polymorphic Type Checking and many other topics.

resources.name: The SSA Book
resources.desc: The only in-depth study of SSA-form (Static Single Assignment Form) in book format.

resources.name: Types and Programming Languages
resources.desc: Comprehensive introduction to the topic of Type Systems and Programming Languages from a Type-Theoretic perspective.

resources.name: Warren's Abstract Machine: Prolog in Haskell
resources.desc: Introduction to WAM from Logic Programming in Prolog.

resources.name: An Evil Copy: How the Loader Betrays You
resources.desc: About security issues related to Dynamic Loading.

resources.name: Compilers Construction, Cambridge
resources.desc: Introduction to compiler construction course from the University of Cambridge.

resources.name: Compiler Construction for Undergrads, RICE University
resources.desc: Introduction to compiler construction and language translators course from the RICE University.

resources.name: Design and Construction of Compilers, University of Texas
resources.desc: Design and construction of compilers including lexical analysis, parsing, code generation techniques, error analysis and simple code optimizations.

resources.name: DSL Design and Implementation Summer School
resources.desc: Summer School program on the topics of DSL Design and Implementation hosted by the EPFL University.

resources.name: Foundations of Programming Languages
resources.desc: Concepts that underlie the design, definition, implementation and use of modern programming languages from a formal standpoint.

resources.name: Nand2Tetris: How to Build a Computer from First Principles, Part 2
resources.desc: This 2nd part of the Nand2Tetris course covers basic language design and elementary compiler construction concepts in addition to many other topics on a basic level.

resources.name: NPTEL's Principles of Compiler Design Course
resources.desc: Introductory course from NPTEL on Compiler Design.

resources.name: NPTEL's Compiler Design Course
